title_en: Nicholas Hoult and Zoë Kravitz Play Modern-Day Robin Hoods in This Exclusive Sneak Peek at the Viral Heist Movie How to Rob a Bank
summary_en: Get an exclusive sneak peek at How to Rob a Bank from IGN Fall Fan Fest. Nicholas Hoult and Zoë Kravitz star in David Leitch's upcoming viral heist movie.
body_en:
Today IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026 shared a new sneak peek at How to Rob a Bank, the new upcoming heist movie starring Nicholas Hoult, Zoë Kravitz, Anna Sawai, Rhenzy Feliz, Christian Slater, with Pete Davidson and John C. Reilly.
The movie tells the story of a group of criminals with a thing for masks and mayhem who go viral sharing their heists on YouTube, but - perhaps not surprisingly - soon catch the attention of law enforcement. During the Amazon MGM Studios CinemaCon presentation, director David Leitch described the gang as “Modern-day Robin Hoods, taking from the rich and giving to poor,” pointing out their motivations lie in fighting greed and corruption.
How To Rob A Bank opens in theaters on November 13.
Fall Fan Fest has 90 exclusive reveals across games, movies, TV, comics, and collectibles. Stream it on IGN to see game announcements, trailers, exclusive clips, celebrity interviews, and more or catch up on anything you missed from Fall Fan Fest right here on IGN.
Rachel Weber is the Head of Editorial Development at IGN and an elder millennial. She's been a professional nerd since 2006 when she got her start on Official PlayStation Magazine in the UK, and has since worked for GamesIndustry.Biz, Rolling Stone and GamesRadar. She loves horror, horror movies, horror games, Red Dead Redemption 2, and her Love and Deepspace boyfriends.
